source.locator: Surah al-Kawthar verses1-3; second body paragraph and bottom footnote (23)

findings: Visual inspection confirms footnote (23) is attached to وقال البزار introducing Ziyad ibn Yahya al-Hassani -> Ibn Abi Adi -> Dawud -> Ikrima -> Ibn Abbas.
Footnote cites Mukhtasar Zawaid al-Bazzar (2/121) (1538), via al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Wasiti from Yahya ibn Rashid from Dawud; this differs above Dawud from the body chain.
Footnote attributes a weak-chain judgment to Ibn Hajar. Body attributes a sahih-chain judgment to Ibn Kathir. Preserve both as reported judgments with differing route context; neither adopted.
R01 Ibn Abbas/Ikrima abbreviated attribution remains separate from R02. No Tabari upper-chain substitution.
This is a visually verified citation in an Ibn Kathir edition, not inspection of the cited Mukhtasar or direct al-Bazzar edition. Existing English fidelity findings not reverified here.
